narrative.overview:
FANILO reads like civic signage for rumours: a chalk ground, green-black ink, square-ish edges, heavy Bricolage Grotesque words and one citron that says "here". The same world serves the newsroom desk (`/w/…`) and the public site (`/`, `/verifies`, `/signaler`, `/suivi`, sign-in and sign-up); there is no second identity. A screen is a notice board you can act on: a big field to paste a message, a numbered line that shows how far a dossier has come, and verdicts stated as words with icons, never as colour alone.

The organising device is the **numbered line**: 01 L'affirmation, 02 Les éléments, 03 La conclusion. It explains the method on the home page, runs live on Vérifier, sits mini on each dossier row and runs down the gutter of a claim's page. FANILO's own work shows in an **ink panel** (the live log « Le travail de FANILO », the public answer, the newsroom band), so machine activity is always visually separate from the journalist's page. The AI only suggests: suggestion is drawn dashed, a journalist's confirmation is drawn solid.

Density is calm and legible rather than packed: Bricolage Grotesque for every word a person reads (a cracked phone in full sun is the reference reader), generous 18px leads, 44–48px touch targets for the main controls. Motion is short and once: highlights sweep in, sources arrive, the verdict lands, the active step breathes; all of it collapses under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
keyCharacteristics: One world for desk and public site; light and dark themes from the same tokens.
Citron (`#0a0a0b`) only for the one action of a screen, the active step and highlights.
Verdicts always icon + word on their own four-token family; status always ink icons.
The numbered line 01/02/03 as the reused signature.
Ink panels for FANILO's live work; square-ish corners (2–4px); flat, no ambient shadows.

rules.name: The One Citron Rule
rules.body: Citron marks the one action of a screen, the active step, the active nav item and highlighted phrases. Never a verdict, a status, a decoration or a second competing button.

rules.name: The Word-and-Icon Rule
rules.body: A verdict is always its lucide icon plus its word in the verdict's ink. Colour alone never carries a verdict.

rules.name: The Status-Is-Not-Truth Rule
rules.body: Workflow status (À vérifier CircleDashed, En cours Timer, Vérifié ShieldCheck, Publié Radio) uses ink icons, muted only for « À vérifier »; never a verdict colour.

rules.name: The 4.5 Rule
rules.body: Every text pair is ≥ 4.5:1 in both themes, measured against its real ground. No opacity on text; placeholders use `muted-foreground`; disabled controls sit at 60 %.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Labels and headings are sentence case. No uppercase tracked eyebrow or kicker above a heading; meta sits under the title.

rules.name: The Two-Voices Rule
rules.body: Bricolage Grotesque speaks (titles, numbers, verdicts); Atkinson is read. Do not set paragraphs in Bricolage Grotesque or verdict words in Atkinson.

rules.name: The Flat-Ground Rule
rules.body: Cards and panels sit flat on a hairline or a tonal change. A shadow means "this is moving or live", never "this is important".

dos: **Do** build every new screen from these tokens and components: `.page-title` H1 with meta under it, the check field, `StepLine`/`StepDisc` for progress, `VerdictChip`/`VerdictBadge`/the verdict block for verdicts, the live panel for anything FANILO is doing.
**Do** give each screen exactly one `variant="action"` button; everything else is primary, outline or ghost.
**Do** draw an AI suggestion dashed and a journalist's confirmation solid, and leave the final verdict to a journalist's explicit click.
**Do** pair every verdict with its icon and word, and every status with its ink lucide icon.
**Do** measure every new text pair in light and dark against its real ground (≥ 4.5:1); use `*-ink` tokens for coloured text on light grounds.
**Do** keep corners at 2–4px and edges as 1px hairlines; reserve full rounds for discs, avatars and pills.
**Do** pad the page when the assistant opens on desktop (`lg:pr-[25rem]`) and use the bottom sheet on phone.
**Do** keep motion single-shot (`.arrive`, `.verdict-land`, `.signal-mark`) except the active step and recording indicators, and respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** use the shared neutral quote rule (1px hairline on the left of a quoted passage) for verbatim quotes; it is a quotation mark, not an accent.
donts: **Don't** use citron for a verdict, a status, an icon bullet, a badge that is not the active step or a second action on the same screen.
**Don't** carry a verdict by colour alone, or colour a status with a verdict family.
**Don't** put an uppercase tracked eyebrow or kicker above a heading.
**Don't** add coloured border-left accents to cards, callouts or rows.
**Don't** let the assistant float over the page on desktop.
**Don't** set text in opacity or in the `input` stroke colour.
**Don't** add ambient shadows to cards; depth is tone and hairline.

**Don't** bring back the retired worlds (« Grille d'antenne » green rail and signal yellow, « Le dossier » manila, Anton, Special Elite, halftoned photographs) in the app. The pitch kit (`docs/pitch/`, `scripts/pitch_video.py`) still uses Anton, Special Elite and the photographs in `public/site/`; they belong to the pitch kit only and are not part of the app's system.
